This multicenter retrospective observational study included 166 patients with severe or greater TR, of whom 140 (84.3%) underwent TTVr and 26 (15.7%) underwent transcatheter tricuspid valve replacement.

sources.title: Artificial Intelligence-Based Analysis of Right Ventricular Work Is ...
sources.snippet: A dedicated AI-based software was used to reconstruct the RV pressure curve based on the peak RV systolic pressure and to fuse the reconstructed curve with 3D RV longitudinal strain and volumetric data to construct PSV loops and calculate corresponding RV work parameters.
